content: Alcohol robs a human of intellect, dignity, and the respect of loved ones. (Kural 921)
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation:
In the Sangam masterpiece of the Tirukkural, Thiruvalluvar provides a universal ethical compass for integrating righteous duty (*Aram*), practical prosperity (*Porul*), and enduring human nobility.

This passage emphasizes the vital importance of alcohol and robs in human life. By moving beyond superficial distractions and grounding attention in timeless ethical principles, we cultivate inner stability, clarity of thought, and genuine resilience.

True realization is never an abstract academic debate—it is an active discipline practiced through conscious daily choices and unwavering integrity.
practicalInsight: Take deliberate ownership of alcohol today: pause before reacting in moments of pressure, and choose the grounded response of integrity and calm.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you compromising your deeper truth regarding alcohol, and how can you align with greater clarity today?
